summary: Tested per-game ad-chances persistence (FE-1..FE-6) on Higher or Lower, Memory Match, Math Sprint, Tic-Tac-Toe. FE-1 (initial ad gate) and FE-2 (grant→10/10, consume→9/10 within same session) PASS for HL. However FE-3 FAILS hard: after router.back() and re-entering HL, chancesLeft resets to 0/10 and the rewarded-ad modal re-appears — the original bug is NOT fixed. FE-4 (full page reload) also fails (consequence of FE-3). FE-6 inspection shows NO entries written for keys tm:game:hl / tm:game:memory / tm:game:math / tm:game:ttt in either window.localStorage or indexedDB after grantChances() runs — meaning AsyncStorage.setItem is effectively a no-op on this web build, so the hook re-mounts with default state every navigation.

integration_issues.flow: Per-game ad-chances persistence via useGameSession + AsyncStorage
integration_issues.issue: AsyncStorage writes from useGameSession are not landing in any web storage. After grantChances() the in-memory state is correct (UI shows 10/10) and the persist useEffect runs (firstWrite gate is bypassed on subsequent state changes), but window.localStorage and indexedDB.databases() are both empty for tm:game:* keys. On re-mount (back→re-enter or full reload) the hydrate effect finds nothing, leaves state at chancesLeft=0/hasUnlocked=false, and the first-mount auto-ad-gate fires again. Net effect: bug originally reported by user (chances lost on app close) is still present in the web build.

action_items: Investigate why @react-native-async-storage/async-storage is not writing on this Expo web build. Verify the installed version supports web — older versions require explicit web setup. Check package.json / yarn.lock for the AsyncStorage version and ensure the web entry exists.

Add a console.log around the AsyncStorage.setItem call in useGameSession (line 85) and around getItem (line 56) to confirm whether the call is even reached and whether it throws (currently swallowed by .catch(() => {})). The silent catch is hiding the root cause.
Consider using a small abstraction that explicitly falls back to window.localStorage on web (Platform.OS === 'web') so persistence is deterministic and easy to inspect.

After fix, re-verify: (a) localStorage/indexedDB contains tm:game:hl JSON with chancesLeft/totalPlays/hasUnlocked after grant, (b) router.back()→re-enter shows 9/10 not 0/10 and no auto ad-modal, (c) full page reload preserves the same value.
Apply the same fix uniformly for memory-match, math-sprint, tic-tac-toe (all four share the hook so a single fix should cover all).
critical_code_review_comments: useGameSession.ts:85 — AsyncStorage.setItem(...).catch(() => {}) silently swallows the actual persistence failure. Log the error at least once in dev to make this kind of regression visible.
useGameSession.ts:51-72 — Good hydrated-flag design, but it can't help when setItem itself never lands. Consider awaiting the write and surfacing failures to a top-level error boundary or Sentry.

Expo Router warnings in console: routes 'admin/game-limits', 'coin-mine', 'plinko', 'treasure-hunt' are referenced by the layout but don't exist in /app/frontend/app — clean up _layout.tsx route list.

success_rate.frontend: approx 30% (FE-1, FE-2 within-session pass; FE-3, FE-4, FE-5 all fail; FE-6 fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://github-sync-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Welcome screen → tap text 'Continue' to auto-login. To reach Earn tab, click the bottom-most element with textContent === 'Earn' (multiple Earn texts exist; the visible one with the largest top offset is the tab). Each game card has testID earn-game-{higher-lower|memory|tictactoe|math}. Inside each game the chances element has testID {hl|memory|math|ttt}-chances. Rewarded ad modal: [data-testid='rewarded-ad'] with claim button [data-testid='rewarded-claim-btn'] available after the 3s countdown. AsyncStorage is NOT writing on web in this build — verify with `await indexedDB.databases()` and `Object.keys(window.localStorage)` after grant. Clean state needs both localStorage.clear() and deleting every IndexedDB DB before reload, because some saved state may already exist.
rca_of_issue: Symptom: chancesLeft resets to 0 and rewarded-ad modal pops every time the user enters any of the 4 games. Reproduction: 1) Open app fresh, 2) tap Continue, 3) tap Earn tab, 4) tap Higher or Lower, 5) wait 3s, tap Claim Reward — UI shows 10/10. 6) tap back-btn, 7) tap Higher or Lower again — modal re-appears and UI shows 0/10. Confirmed in this run. Root cause hypothesis: AsyncStorage.setItem is silently failing (the .catch swallows it). Net result: hydrate reads nothing → state stays at defaults → first-mount effect re-arms the ad gate. The hook logic itself is sound; the storage layer is the failure point. Mitigation: log/await the setItem and ensure the underlying web driver of @react-native-async-storage/async-storage is registered (or fall back manually to window.localStorage on web).
